question: The important milestones of the SHG Bank linkage movement was spearheaded by _______ with support from RBI.
solution:
The correct answer is **NABARD**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NABARD** stands for National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.
 
• NABARD was instrumental in **spearheading the SHG Bank linkage movement**.
 
• This movement aimed to link **Self-Help Groups (SHGs) with banks** to facilitate microfinance.
 
• The initiative received strong support from the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 SEBI: Securities and Exchange Board of India, primarily regulates the securities market.
 
 

 Option 2
 Indian Bank: A major public sector bank in India, but not primarily associated with SHG linkage.
 
 

 Option 3
 NABARD: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development, key player in SHG Bank linkage.
 
 

 Option 4
 Cooperative Bank: Provides financial services to cooperatives, but not the main entity for SHG linkage.
